description: The LiteGraph barrel and global singleton that custom nodes and extensions consume: node type registration and creation, global configuration, late-bound instance access, deprecation feedback, and canvas polyfills.

characterizationScenarios.name: The LiteGraph barrel exposes the supported extension API
Extensions register node types and receive litegraph events

compatibilityPromises: Names exported from packages/litegraph/src/litegraph.ts and the LiteGraph global stay available to extensions; removals need deprecation warnings.
Model, canvas, and widget modules may keep importing the barrel during inventory to avoid the LGraph and Subgraph initialisation cycle.
